acceptanceCriteria: 版本身份、tag 目标、workflow source revision 和 ReleasePlan 一致。
公开 Release 包含四个受支持目标的 manifest、checksums、SBOM、provenance，且制品身份可复核。
完成 fresh install 与 v0.2.112 到 v0.2.113 的 N-1 升级验收；失败证据保留且不误报完成。
完成 Runtime archive、provider finalization、finalize-verify、close、文档投影和精确分支/worktree 清理。
goal: 从已同步且 CI 通过的 main 发布 v0.2.113，取得不可变 tag、公开 Release、四目标制品与供应链证据，完成公开安装和 N-1 升级验收、Runtime 归档/finalize/close、文档投影和精确资源清理。
intent: 完成 AI Cockpit v0.2.113 的受支持公开发布、验收与生命周期收尾。
outOfScope: 不修改历史 Release、历史 tag、旧候选或失败证据。
不生成 Intel macOS 公开资产，不新增任务进度 API、手工账本或全局 Agent/MCP 配置。
不绕过 Runtime、release workflow、公开安装验收或清理门禁。

scenarioCoverage.expected: The reviewed main revision, package version, annotated tag, workflow source revision, and typed ReleasePlan identify the same v0.2.113 candidate.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run the declared local policy checks, then inspect the release preflight, tag, and hosted workflow identity receipts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: The public v0.2.113 Release contains the four supported target archives and matching manifest, checksums, SBOM, provenance, and source identity without Intel macOS publication.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the immutable tag, provider Release, release manifest, SHA256SUMS, SBOM, provenance, and downloaded archive digests after the hosted publication workflow completes.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Downloaded public v0.2.113 artifacts pass isolated fresh-install and v0.2.112-to-v0.2.113 N-1 upgrade acceptance with cleanup evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Use the existing release adopter acceptance jobs and inspect their immutable artifact, isolated-root, install, upgrade, and cleanup receipts.

scenarioCoverage.expected: Any failed publication or post-release acceptance records the failure without rewriting the immutable tag, provider Release, or predecessor evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Inspect the release and close receipts for explicit failure roots, immutable identity, and preserved predecessor evidence.

scenarioCoverage.expected: After successful finalization and close, repeated status/projection checks produce no new cleanup obligation, successor, or mutable historical evidence.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run finalize-verify, close, documentation projection, and repeated read-only status checks, then inspect exact branch/worktree/provider cleanup.

sources: public Release v0.2.112 and immutable tag v0.2.112
